section_summary.extract_value: This section, titled 'References', details the copyright ownership of Social Behavior & Personality: an international journal by the Society for Personality Research. It specifies that content may not be copied, emailed to multiple sites, or posted to a listserv without explicit written permission, though individual users are permitted to print, download, or email articles for personal use.
